verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a card-issuing program, including virtual and physical cards, spending limits, and expiry dates. However, the pack has no evidence of API-driven lifecycle transitions: activate, pause or unpause, report lost or stolen, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, or permanently close. Spend controls and expiry settings are adjacent features, not lifecycle state management, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, the full card lifecycle is API-driven — activate, pause, unpause, report lost or stolen, reissue with a replacement linked to the original, and permanently close
